name: Romanian deadlift
notes: Barbell hip hinge emphasizing the hamstrings.

guide.setup: Stand tall holding the bar at the thighs with feet hip width, a soft knee bend, and a braced trunk.
guide.execution: Push the hips back while sliding the bar down the legs, then drive the hips forward once the hamstrings are stretched.
guide.cues: Keep the bar close. Reach hips back. Maintain a soft knee bend.
guide.mistakes: Turning it into a squat; rounding to reach lower; bar drifting away; overextending at the top.
